    21→function humanizeSlugSegment(value: string): string {
    22→  const raw = value.split("/").filter(Boolean).pop() ?? value;
    23→  return raw
    24→    .replace(/[-_]+/g, " ")
    25→    .replace(/\b\w/g, (char) => char.toUpperCase());
    26→}
    27→
    28→function getSystemLocationLabel(location: DesktopLocation): string | undefined {
    29→  switch (location.kind) {
    30→    case "workspace-apps":
    31→      return i18n.t("page.pages", "Apps");
    32→    case "workspace-section":
    33→      return getWorkspaceSectionLabel(location.section) || location.section;
    34→    case "settings":
    35→      return location.section
    36→        ? getSettingsSectionLabel(location.section)
    37→        : getSettingsSectionLabel();
    38→    case "documents":
    39→      return "Documents";
    40→    case "device-pair":
    41→      return "Devices";
    42→    case "global-route": {
    43→      const normalizedPath =
    44→        location.path.split("?")[0]?.split("#")[0] ?? location.path;
    45→      return GLOBAL_ROUTE_META[normalizedPath]?.label;
    46→    }
    47→    default:
    48→      return undefined;
    49→  }
    50→}
    51→
    52→function getSystemLocationIcon(location: DesktopLocation): IconData | undefined {
    53→  switch (location.kind) {
    54→    case "workspace-apps":
    55→      return { type: "lucide", value: "layout-grid" };
    56→    case "workspace-section":
    57→      return getWorkspaceSectionDescriptor(location.section)?.icon;
    58→    case "settings":
    59→      return location.section
    60→        ? getSettingsSectionIcon(location.section)
    61→        : { type: "lucide", value: "settings" };
    62→    case "documents":
    63→      return { type: "lucide", value: "file-text" };
    64→    case "device-pair":
    65→      return { type: "lucide", value: "smartphone" };
    66→    case "global-route": {
    67→      const normalizedPath =
    68→        location.path.split("?")[0]?.split("#")[0] ?? location.path;
    69→      return GLOBAL_ROUTE_META[normalizedPath]?.icon;
    70→    }
    71→    default:
    72→      return undefined;
    73→  }
    74→}

    96→            : humanizeSlugSegment(segments[index]),
    97→        icon:
    98→          index === segments.length - 1
    99→            ? leaf?.icon
   100→            : undefined,
   101→        meta: {

   104→        },
   105→        location: {
   106→          kind: "workspace-page",
   107→          workspaceId,
   108→          pageSlug: slugAtDepth,
   109→        },
   110→      })
   111→    );
   112→  }
   113→
   114→  return items;
   115→}

   512→function createWorkspaceRootItem(

   561→function buildWorkspacePageBreadcrumbStack(

   572→  const pageItems = pathSlugs.map((slug) => {
   573→    const matchedPage = pages?.find((page) => page.slug === slug);
   574→    const fallbackLabel = slug.split("/").filter(Boolean).pop() ?? slug;
   575→
   576→    return createLocationBreadcrumbItem(
   577→      {
   578→        kind: "workspace-page",
   579→        workspaceId,
   580→        pageSlug: slug,

   582→      {
   583→        id: `${workspaceId}:page:${slug}`,
   584→        descriptorId: "workspace-page",

   589→          pageSlug: slug,
   590→        },
   591→      }
   592→    );
   593→  });

   595→  return [

   704→function buildExecutorChildBreadcrumbStack(

   764→      id,

   772→
   773→export function resolveLocationNavigation(
   774→  input: ResolveLocationNavigationInput
   775→): ResolvedLocationNavigation {
   776→  if (input.breadcrumbStack?.length) {
   777→    return {
   778→      breadcrumbStack: input.breadcrumbStack,
   779→      leaf: input.breadcrumbStack[input.breadcrumbStack.length - 1],
   780→    };
   781→  }
   782→
   783→  let breadcrumbStack: BreadcrumbStackItem[];
   784→
   785→  switch (input.location.kind) {
   786→    case "workspace-apps":
   787→      breadcrumbStack = createStackForLocation(
   788→        input.location,
   789→        input.title,
   790→        input.icon
   791→      );
   792→      break;
   793→    case "workspace-page":
   794→      breadcrumbStack = buildWorkspacePageBreadcrumbStack(
   795→        input.location.workspaceId,
   796→        input.location.pageSlug,
   797→        input.pages,
   798→        input.workspace
   799→      );
   800→      break;
   801→    case "workspace-agent-detail":
   802→      breadcrumbStack = buildWorkspaceAgentDetailBreadcrumbStack(
   803→        input.location,
   804→        input.workspace,
   805→        {
   806→          title: input.title,
   807→          icon: input.icon,
   808→        }
   809→      );
   810→      break;
   811→    case "workspace-executor-detail":
   812→      breadcrumbStack = buildWorkspaceExecutorDetailBreadcrumbStack(
   813→        input.location,
   814→        input.workspace,
   815→        {
   816→          title: input.title,
   817→          icon: input.icon,
   818→        }
   819→      );
   820→      break;
   821→    case "workspace-web":
   822→      breadcrumbStack = buildWorkspaceWebBreadcrumbStack(
   823→        input.location,
   824→        input.pages,
   825→        input.workspace,
   826→        {
   827→          title: input.title,
   828→          icon: input.icon,
   829→        }
   830→      );
   831→      break;
   832→    case "skill-detail":
   833→    case "mcp-server-detail":
   834→    case "subagent-detail":
   835→    case "prompt-detail":
   836→    case "command-detail":
   837→      breadcrumbStack = buildExecutorChildBreadcrumbStack(
   838→        input.location,
   839→        input.workspace,
   840→        {
   841→          title: input.title,
   842→          icon: input.icon,
   843→        }

   846→    default:
   847→      breadcrumbStack = createStackForLocation(

   849→        input.title,

   851→      );
   852→      break;
   853→  }
   854→
   855→  // Patch root item with workspace name if available
   856→  if (input.workspace && breadcrumbStack.length > 0 && breadcrumbStack[0].descriptorId === "workspace") {

## `PageTab` and `TabState` in `tab-store.ts`

```typescript
interface PageTab {
  id: string;
  pinned: boolean;
  historyIndex: number;
  navigationHistory: TabNavigationState[];
  viewMode?: PageViewMode;   // "skill" | "page"
}

interface TabState {
  tabs: PageTab[];
  activeTabId: string | null;
  recentlyClosedTabs: ClosedTabSnapshot[];
}
```

`TabViewModel` (derived computed view):
```typescript
interface TabViewModel extends PageTab {
  currentState: TabNavigationState | null;
  currentLocation: DesktopLocation | null;
  label: string;
  icon?: BreadcrumbStackItem["icon"];
  descriptorId?: string;
  meta?: BreadcrumbStackItem["meta"];
  url: string | null;
}
```

`ClosedTabSnapshot`: `{ tab: PageTab, closedAt: number, originIndex: number }`

Key tab store methods: `openTab`, `closeTab`, `closeOtherTabs`, `closeTabsToRight`, `setActiveTab`, `pinTab/unpinTab`, `setViewMode`, `moveTab`, `navigate`, `navigateToLocation`, `replaceLocation`, `pushLocation`, `insertHistoryBeforeCurrent`, `pushPage`, `popTo`, `resetStack`, `jumpToHistory`, `goBack/goForward`, `canGoBack/canGoForward`, `closeAllTabs`, `duplicateTab`, `reopenClosedTab`, `restoreTab`.

Storage key: `"viben-tab-store-v2"` (persisted via `zustand/middleware`).

## Key `navigate` Functions in `use-desktop-routing.ts`

The hook returns a `DesktopRoutingApi` object. The primary navigation functions and their delegation:

**High-level workspace navigation:**
- `openWorkspaceHome(workspaceId, opts)` - calls `tabActions.openLocation({ kind:"workspace-home", workspaceId })`
- `openWorkspaceApps(workspaceId, opts)` - calls `tabActions.openLocation({ kind:"workspace-apps", workspaceId })`
- `openWorkspaceSection(workspaceId, section, opts)` - supports `stackMode:"push"` or default open; calls `pushChildPage` or `tabActions.openLocation`
- `openWorkspaceAgentList(workspaceId, opts)` - delegates to `openWorkspaceSection(..., "agent")`
- `openWorkspaceAgentDetail(workspaceId, agentId, opts)` - calls `openChildLocation`
- `pushWorkspaceAgentDetail(...)` - same but forces `stackMode:"push"`
- `openWorkspaceExecutorDetail(workspaceId, executorType, opts)` - calls `openChildLocation`
- `pushWorkspaceExecutorDetail(...)` - same but forces `stackMode:"push"`
- `openWorkspacePage(workspaceId, pageSlug, opts)` - calls `tabActions.openLocation({ kind:"workspace-page", ... })`
- `openWorkspaceWeb(workspaceId, { url, title, webId }, opts)` - calls `tabActions.openLocation({ kind:"workspace-web", ... })`

**Global routes:**
- `openSettings(section?, opts)` - calls `tabActions.openLocation({ kind:"settings", section })`
- `openDocuments(opts)` - calls `tabActions.openLocation({ kind:"documents" })`
- `openDevicePair(opts)` - calls `tabActions.openLocation({ kind:"device-pair" })`
- `openDashboard(opts)` - calls `openPath("/mcp-services/dashboard", ...)`
- `openSkillsMarket(opts)` - calls `openPath("/skills-market", ...)`
- `openAgentDetail(agentId, workspacePath?, opts)` - calls `openChildLocation({ kind:"agent-detail", ... })`
- `openExecutorDetail(executorType, workspacePath?, opts)` - calls `openChildLocation({ kind:"executor-detail", ... })`
- `openSkillDetail/openMcpServerDetail/openSubagentDetail/openPromptDetail/openCommandDetail` - all call `openChildLocation`

**Core primitives:**
- `openRoute(route, opts)` - calls `tabActions.openLocation(route, { openInNewTab })`
- `focusOrOpenRoute(route)` - calls `tabActions.openLocation(route)` (no new-tab)
- `openPath(path, input?)` - either `tabActions.openLocation` (new-tab) or `tabActions.navigateTo(path, breadcrumb)` (current tab)
- `pushChildPage(item, location, opts)` - either `tabActions.openLocation` (new-tab) or `tabActions.pushPage(item, location)`
- `pushCurrentPageChild(pageSlug, opts)` - builds workspace-page location from current workspace, calls `pushChildPage`
- `openCurrentPageWeb(url, input?)` - builds workspace-web location, calls `pushChildPage`
- `handleDeepLink(intent)` - calls `openRoute(intent.route, { openMode: intent.openMode })`

**Internal routing logic: `openChildLocation`**
The key private function that all detail-page openers flow through. It decides between:
1. New tab: `tabActions.openLocation(..., { openInNewTab: true, breadcrumbStack })`
2. Explicit breadcrumb stack: `tabActions.pushLocation` or `tabActions.openLocation`
3. Same-workspace push: `pushChildPage(item, location, { mode: stackMode })`
4. Cross-workspace open: `tabActions.openLocation(location)`

**History navigation:**
- `goBack()` / `goForward()` - delegated to `tabNav.goBackInTab` / `tabNav.goForwardInTab`
- `popToBreadcrumb(index)` - calls `tabActions.popTo(index)`
- `closeCurrentTab()` - calls `tabActions.closeTab(activeTabId)`
- `detachCurrentTabToNewWindow()` - calls `tabActions.detachTabToNewWindow(activeTabId)`

## How the Files Relate

```
App.tsx
  └── BrowserRouter / Routes
        └── TabRouterBridge (syncs React Router ↔ tab store)
              ├── reads: tab-store (activeTab, historyIndex → targetUrl)
              ├── writes: tab-store.navigateToLocation / openTab
              └── uses: navigation-meta.urlToLocation / locationToUrl

tab-store.ts
  ├── stores: PageTab[] (each with navigationHistory: TabNavigationState[])
  ├── calls: tab-navigation.ts (createTabNavigationState, pushPage, popTo)
  ├── calls: location-navigation.ts (createStackForLocation)
  └── calls: navigation-meta.ts (locationToUrl, urlToLocation, normalizeSettingsSection)

use-desktop-routing.ts
  ├── uses: tab-store (via use-page-tabs hooks for tabActions)
  ├── uses: navigation-meta (urlToLocation, DesktopLocation types)
  └── uses: breadcrumb-stack (createLocationBreadcrumbItem)

navigation-meta.ts        ← core type hub, location↔URL conversion
breadcrumb-stack.ts       ← atomic stack operations
tab-navigation.ts         ← TabNavigationState state machine
location-navigation.ts    ← Location → BreadcrumbStack resolution (workspace-aware)
navigation-state.ts       ← generic BreadcrumbNodeDescriptor helpers
deep-link.ts              ← viben:// URL parser
page-navigation-extractor.ts ← Markdown/DOM link extraction
page-index.ts             ← virtual page index tree building
```
